terms.label: chemical entity
terms.definition: A chemical entity is a physical entity of interest in chemistry.

terms.label: molecular entity
terms.definition: Any constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, etc.

terms.label: atom
terms.definition: A chemical entity constituting the smallest component of an element.

terms.label: metal atom
terms.definition: An atom of an element that exhibits typical metallic properties.

terms.label: iron atom
terms.definition: An element with atomic number 26.

terms.label: calcium atom
terms.definition: An element with atomic number 20.

terms.label: organic molecular entity
terms.definition: A molecular entity that contains carbon.

terms.label: polypeptide
terms.definition: A peptide containing ten or more amino acid residues.

terms.label: protein
terms.definition: A biological macromolecule minimally consisting of one polypeptide chain.

terms.label: oxygen molecular entity
terms.definition: A molecular entity containing oxygen.

terms.label: water
terms.definition: An oxygen hydride consisting of an oxygen atom covalently bonded to two hydrogen atoms.

terms.label: methanol
terms.definition: The simplest alcohol, consisting of a methyl group linked to a hydroxyl group.

terms.label: ethanol
terms.definition: A primary alcohol that is ethane in which one hydrogen is substituted by a hydroxy group.

terms.label: fatty acid
terms.definition: Any aliphatic monocarboxylic acid derived from or contained in esterified form in an animal or vegetable fat.

terms.label: hexadecanoic acid
terms.definition: A C16 straight-chain saturated fatty acid.

terms.label: carbohydrate
terms.definition: Any member of the class of organooxygen compounds that is a polyhydroxyaldehyde, polyhydroxyketone, or derivative thereof.

terms.label: D-glucopyranose
terms.definition: The D-enantiomer of glucopyranose.

terms.label: L-ascorbic acid
terms.definition: The L-enantiomer of ascorbic acid, also known as vitamin C.

terms.label: sodium atom
terms.definition: An element with atomic number 11.

terms.label: potassium atom
terms.definition: An element with atomic number 19.
